scope: Preserve saved workflow blueprints through concurrent writes and failed imports; keep workflow controls readable at smaller window sizes.

baseline.qualification: Previous exact-head CI passed. Blueprint lost-update and false-success risks were identified through code review; no separate pre-fix failing baseline run was performed.

implementation: Serialize blueprint saves, removals and atomic batch upserts on one recoverable queue; merge against the latest acknowledged collection and deep-copy inputs before enqueue.

Validate the whole batch, duplicate IDs and inline secrets before writing. Require a native setter and reject false acknowledgements; publish only after accepted persistence, retaining legacy undefined acknowledgements from a real setter.
Import a validated bundle in one write; preserve input ordering and unrelated saved rows. Rejected imports do not leave partial rows.

Guard blueprint actions before awaits and release in finally. Keep selection/name stable while pending, retain newer goal/command edits, and catch save/import/delete/export failures without false success.
Stack workflow title/actions below the wide-screen breakpoint, keep full labels and icons, and use consistent button height.
Native save/import and actual process restart retain all three blueprint identities and ordering; deletion preserves the working goal and commands.
Native scheduled-run recovery retains its original identity and zero launch POSTs while checking layouts and scoped Axe in both themes at standard and actual minimum native window sizes.
Associate Commands with a separate visible label so its exact label remains stable when a saved multi-step definition populates the textarea.

verification.queue_qualification: Unit/static checks and the native phases share one sequential Buildr admission.

native_failures: The expanded four theme/window passes with page reloads exceeded the scheduled case's 60-second budget under shared workstation load. The revised case uses the actual theme switch, retaining all layout, accessibility and recovery assertions.

The exact Commands label included the nested populated textarea's text. Native snapshots and the screenshot already showed successful restoration. A separate explicit label fixes the semantic association while retaining exact label assertions.
earlier_attempt.qualification: Observed test/harness failures, not attributed to Buildr. Failed reports, traces, screenshots and source hashes retained under dist/verification/blueprint-508630d23aaf-failure.

intermediate_static_failure.reason: An unsupported exact option in a new Testing Library getByRole assertion failed the renderer typecheck. Removed the option; string name matching remains exact by default.
intermediate_static_failure.native_phase: Not run after static gate failure.
intermediate_static_failure.qualification: Test-source type error, not a Buildr failure.

checks: Real repository Vite test configuration; single worker

native.scope: Workflow header and pending schedule, dark/light at standard/minimum native window sizes

scheduled_recovery.qualification: Computed style checks preserve visible button text before/after the scoped Axe scan; this does not replace the test's accessibility analysis.

native.qualification: Owned native profiles and controlled HTTP fixture; real memory-only credential fallback, encrypted configuration storage and normal native bridges. Not host keyring or live engine/Temporal/sandbox/provider/NSR acceptance.

source_guard.qualification: Manual before/after hashes, not an immutable queue snapshot.

dependency_audit.qualification: Unchanged package/lock bytes retain the prior source-bound audit (production 0, development 15 affected-package entries). This is not a fresh full audit; the new exact-head CI production gate is required.

verification.full_ci: Required on the next committed source. Focused/native checks do not establish full platform/bundle/installer acceptance.

limitations: The batch is one local collection write; tests do not establish a cross-device transaction or live workflow execution.
Repeated imports after successful persistence intentionally create new copies; failed atomic imports can be retried without partial local rows.
Scoped Axe and controlled screenshots do not establish whole-application accessibility certification.
Signed release and live service acceptance remain gated; immutable v1.1.20 stays at fe2f9d6 and this is unreleased branch work.
